variants.title: Seasoned rider
variants.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: photographic image for the right two-thirds of a landscape 4-by-3-inch Harley-Davidson eyewear event card.
Make one realistic color photograph, portrait orientation approximately 6:7, at least 1536 pixels wide if possible. Edge-to-edge image ONLY, no card mockup, no layout, no typography, no borders, no watermark.
Composition: the photo will occupy a near-square portrait panel beside a dark contact panel on its left. The subject looks slightly toward image-left, leading toward that contact panel. Keep the whole head and glasses comfortably inside the upper two-thirds, with breathing room at the top. The lowest 18% will receive a dark brand caption overlay later, so all faces and eyewear must be above it. Eyewear and face are the primary focus, motorcycle details the secondary focus. Tight enough to read instantly at small printed size.
Style: believable premium documentary motorcycle-rally photography, natural skin pores, individual hair and beard strands, lightly worn leather, honest chrome and paint reflections, restrained warm coastal afternoon light, slightly shallow depth of field. Physically plausible bodies, glasses, hands and motorcycle parts; five fingers per hand; conventional Harley cruiser geometry. No artificial glossy skin, illustration, CGI, fake HDR, oversharpening, fashion-runway posing, fake text, random patches, invented slogans, alcohol, or smoke. Wraparound black riding sunglasses must actually be worn over the eyes, with normal temples behind the ears; not on forehead. The frames are illustrative and should carry no fabricated model number or impact-rating mark. Motorcycle can be recognizably Harley-Davidson through its actual tank shape, exposed V-twin, fork and headlamp styling; avoid decorative gibberish branding.
Scene and subject: an approachable, rugged man around 50 with a short salt-and-pepper beard and sun-weathered face, wearing fitted matte-black wraparound riding sunglasses and a worn black leather riding jacket over a dark tee. He is sitting naturally on a STATIONARY, parked black Harley-Davidson cruiser at a coastal rally pull-off, relaxed shoulders, a subtle confident half-smile, face turned slightly left. Cropped from head to upper thigh: his face large near the upper center/right, the real-looking teardrop tank and a chrome handlebar visible in the lower half, a gloved hand resting naturally on the near handlebar. Hint of Atlantic sky and out-of-focus parked motorcycles behind him. Strong simple silhouette, inviting rather than aggressive. A single coherent image.
variants.alt: AI concept: a seasoned rider wearing wraparound glasses on a parked Harley-Davidson cruiser; based on the supplied HZ0051 reference
variants.description: My first pick: one strong face, prominent glasses and a recognizable Harley. The simplest read at card size. Uses the supplied HZ0051 frame as a visual guide.
variants.refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the edit target: the existing photorealistic rider photograph for an event-card front. Image 2 is a PRODUCT REFERENCE ONLY: a small supplier screenshot of Harley-Davidson eyewear HZ0051.
Change only the sunglasses worn by the rider in Image 1 to faithfully follow the shape, frame color, lens color, proportions, side details and temples of the HZ0051 glasses in Image 2: a dark black/charcoal wraparound safety-riding frame, gray smoke lenses, substantial protective sides, red-orange interior accents, with the black retention strap shown in the product reference.
Fit the reference glasses realistically on the existing face, over the eyes, with convincing perspective, normal nose contact, temples at ears and natural reflections. For frames with straps, route the strap naturally behind the head without introducing extra arms, floating straps, facial occlusion or changes to the person's hair.
Keep everything else from Image 1 unchanged: identity, face shape, expression, gaze toward image-left, skin texture, hair, body position, clothing, hands, motorcycle geometry, coastal background, lighting, color grade, camera crop and portrait aspect ratio.
Do not paste in the product screenshot, white background, availability badge, model text, or product-card layout. Do not add rating marks, fabricated frame logos, visible model numbers, captions, borders or watermarks. Preserve the original photographic realism and resolution. Output one complete edited photograph only.
